caption: Blue Grotto (Grotta Azzurra), Capri
composition: Boat at the cave mouth with electric blue interior glow under Capri cliffs · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: The viewpoint is from the water off Capri's cliffs at midday, facing the mouth of the Blue Grotto. The sunlit limestone cliff fills the left and upper frame, while the dark arch of the cave opens at the center-right, its interior glowing an electric blue. A small wooden boat with two figures floats just inside the glow, and the modelled 23 September 2026, 12:23 sun lights the rock face harshly above the shadowed water.
alt_text: AI-generated artistic interpretation of the Blue Grotto under midday light
